head: thoughtworks/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Eagle3

secondary_4k.comment: Stretch run at ctx=4096, max_new=160. Reported peak_mib 4264 EXCEEDS the card's physical 4096 MiB, i.e. it relied on WSL2 host-memory fallback (oversubscription); timing is degraded by spilling (draft_step_ms 17.0 vs 5.6, target_decode_ms 149 vs 119), so the 1k run above is the clean primary. Acceptance and ratio still clear the gate bar comfortably here too.

note: Greedy chain depth n_draft=4 against dense AWQ Llama-3.2-3B; sparse-path + long-ctx acceptance is a Part-B equivalence concern, not this gate. mean_accepted = mean tokens emitted per iter (1 free/bonus token + accepted drafts). draft_step_ratio = one isolated EAGLE draft step / one isolated target decode step (AWQ bs=1 decode is ~119 ms on this RTX 3050 Ti, so the bf16 draft step is ~21x cheaper). top1_agreement is the sanity check: PaulGraham summary 58.3% at 1k matches the head card's published acc_0=60.6%; the RULER-NIAH workload is highly repetitive filler so its agreement is lower and drags the pooled figure down. Controller computes net = mean_accepted/(0.87+draft_step_ratio) and the verdict.
